description: Source code for hashing and managing directory entries within a Git index, including thread-safe initialization and directory lookup functions.

classes.name: dir_entry
classes.description: Represents a directory entry in the index, including parent linkage and name details.

methods.name: find_dir_entry__hash
methods.description: Finds a directory entry in the hash table by name and hash.

methods.name: find_dir_entry
methods.description: Finds a directory entry in the hash table by name.

methods.name: hash_dir_entry
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a directory entry for a given cache entry, handling parent directories.

methods.name: add_dir_entry
methods.description: Increments reference counts for directory entries and their parents.

methods.name: remove_dir_entry
methods.description: Decrements reference counts and removes directory entries when count reaches zero.

methods.name: hash_index_entry
methods.description: Hashes a cache entry and adds it to the index's hash tables, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: cache_entry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for cache entries in hash table, pointer equality for removal.

methods.name: lazy_try_threaded
methods.description: Flag indicating whether threading is attempted for hash initialization.

methods.name: lazy_nr_dir_threads
methods.description: Number of directory threads to use during lazy initialization.

methods.name: lookup_lazy_params
methods.description: Determines threading parameters based on system and index size.

methods.name: init_dir_mutex
methods.description: Initializes mutex array for directory hash partitioning.

methods.name: cleanup_dir_mutex
methods.description: Destroys mutex array used for directory hash partitioning.

methods.name: lock_dir_mutex
methods.description: Locks a specific mutex in the mutex array.

methods.name: unlock_dir_mutex
methods.description: Unlocks a specific mutex in the mutex array.

methods.name: compute_dir_lock_nr
methods.description: Computes mutex index based on hash bucket.

methods.name: hash_dir_entry_with_parent_and_prefix
methods.description: Creates or finds a directory entry with a given parent and prefix, handling locking.

methods.name: handle_range_1
methods.description: Processes a range of index entries, handling directories and lazy entries.

methods.name: handle_range_dir
methods.description: Handles directory range processing, including recursion for nested directories.

methods.name: lazy_dir_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure for processing directory ranges.

methods.name: lazy_name_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread procedure for processing index entries into the name hash.

methods.name: lazy_update_dir_ref_counts
methods.description: Updates reference counts for directories after lazy initialization.

methods.name: threaded_lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Performs threaded lazy initialization of name and directory hashes.

methods.name: lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Initializes the name hash tables, using threading if appropriate.

methods.name: test_lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Test routine for lazy hash initialization, returns number of threads used.

methods.name: add_name_hash
methods.description: Adds a cache entry to the name hash if initialized.

methods.name: remove_name_hash
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from the name hash if present.

methods.name: same_name
methods.description: Checks if two names are the same, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: index_dir_find
methods.description: Finds a directory entry for a given path, optionally returning canonical path.

methods.name: adjust_dirname_case
methods.description: Adjusts directory name case in a path based on index data.

methods.name: index_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the index, returning the cache entry if found.

methods.name: free_name_hash
methods.description: Frees and clears the name and directory hash tables.
